title: Open5e searches are faster and more reliable
summary: Rules searches in the Catalog and the encounter creature list no longer fail with "The operation was aborted due to timeout" when Open5e is slow.
items: Searches ask Open5e only for the details Lootsplitter shows, so answers arrive sooner.
Recent searches are kept for a day and answered at once, and a saved copy is used for up to a week if Open5e is down.
A slow answer is retried once; if Open5e still cannot answer, a short message explains it and a Retry button repeats the search.
This also helps the installed Android app, which uses the same website search.
